tools.name: create_word_alignment
tools.description:
Create a shareable Word Aligner diagram that shows which words match across two or more stacked lines of text (a translation and its source, an interlinear gloss, IPA, etc.). Returns a URL that opens the interactive diagram, plus a preview image.

Use this when the user wants to translate a phrase a

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_word_alignment · Private data: create_word_alignment · Public sink: create_word_alignment · Destructive: create_word_alignment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_word_alignment · Private data: create_word_alignment · Public sink: create_word_alignment · Destructive: create_word_alignment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_word_alignment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
